data: What is the F1 score of the green line in the right figure when the number of authors is 1000?

The right figure shows the F1 scores for different models on the Blogs dataset. The green line represents the SCAP model. To find the F1 score of the green line when the number of authors is 1000, I need to locate the point where the x-axis value is 1000 and read the corresponding y-axis value for the green line. The green line appears to be at approximately 40 on the y-axis when the x-axis value is 1000. Therefore, the F1 score of the green line in the right figure when the number of authors is 1000 is approximately 40.
